newsitem.title: USA: Esquire seeks to exchange warrants.
newsitem.headline: Esquire seeks to exchange warrants.

text.p: Esquire Communications Ltd said Tuesday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to exchange common stock for redeemable common stock purchase warrants.
The company said it had 1.7 million warrants outstanding.
Their holders are entitled to buy one share of common stock at $4.50 per warrant, it said.
The company said it was offering to exchange one share for every five warrants.
Esquire Communications Ltd provides court reporting and related legal support services.
